'''Mek-Sha''' was an independent [[Fuel/Legends|fueling]] [[Space station/Legends|station]] built inside of a [[Mining/Legends|mined]]-out [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]. It was once controlled by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], and was home to many groups of individuals, including [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] and [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]].

==Description==
The [[Mining station/Legends|mining station]] that would come to be known as Mek-Sha was established within an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. Its limited [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] reserves made it a difficult operation to maintain and expanding the mine network put the station's integrity at risk.<ref name="Mek-Sha" /> The station also explored [[Exonium/Legends|exonium]] deposits.<ref name="A Groundbreaking Opportunity">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|A Groundbreaking Opportunity|[[Mek-Sha]]}}</ref>

After [[Huttbreaker's Rebellion]], it acquired its name and leadership fell to a council composed of the five largest groups:<ref name="Mek-Sha" /> [[Junker Jott's crew]], [[The Brothers]], [[Dar'manda]], [[Harido Wald]], and [[Huttbreaker's crew]].<ref name="Auction" /> Since the revolt, Mek-Sha became a safe harbor to many outlaws such as [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]. The ruling council handled the operation's difficulties by granting fuel rights to the select few who were able to acquire a majority vote from the crews.<ref name="Mek-Sha" />

Mek-Sha was protected by a [[Deflector shield/Legends|mighty shield]] and a [[Mek-Sha's failsafe|failsafe]] which could turn the fuel useless in the event of a new revolt or invasion.<ref name="Mek-Sha" />

==History==
===Origins===
[[File:Mek-Sha2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Mek-Sha's streets]]
First explored by [[Geologist/Legends|geologists]], the Hutt Cartel member [[Loddu]] took forceful claim of the asteroid, being unsatisfied with his share of the profits over the Cartel's capture of [[Makeb]]. Within months, Loddu had transformed it into a crowded place by bringing in [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and guards. Seeking to challenge his rivals' operations on [[Makeb]], he hastened the exploration of resources and demanded the use of explosives to increase the speed of its [[Mining/Legends|mining]]. This led to a large explosion that claimed the lives of Loddu and many other inhabitants.<ref name="Discover" />

===Huttbreaker's Rebellion===
Afterwards, the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Prava]]&mdash;Loddu's minion&mdash;took over the operation unwillingly. On arriving the station, he discovered that the explosion had unearthed a large deposit of resources.<ref name="Discover" />

During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], Prava's attentions were diverted to outside the station and this led to a young slave named [[Huttbreaker|Gritha Dar]] to inspire others to join her against the Hutt. Huttbreaker's Rebellion caught Prava and his mercenaries off-guard and the revolution ended quickly with the rebels victorious.<ref name="Huttbreaker's Rebellion">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=codex|Huttbreaker's Rebellion}}</ref>

===Galactic War===
During the [[Third Galactic War|new conflict]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Mek-Sha was used as a refueling station for a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] on its way to the defense of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="Auction" />
